**Coverage of BR1 to BR12.** BR1 by AC2 and AC3; BR2 by AC4, TC-E7-007-04 and TC-E7-007-06; BR3 by AC2 and TC-E7-007-02; BR4 by AC2, AC3, TC-E7-007-02 and TC-E7-007-03; BR5 and BR6 by AC6 and TC-E7-007-08; BR7 by AC2, AC3, TC-E7-007-02 and TC-E7-007-03; BR8 by AC3 and TC-E7-007-03; BR9 by AC6 and TC-E7-007-08; BR10 by AC2 and TC-E7-007-02; BR11 and BR12 by AC3 and TC-E7-007-03.

**Database and migrations.** Schema ownership: `rwb_deviation` is the only schema this story owns; `rwb_case`, `rwb_decision`, `rwb_guarantee`, `rwb_valuation` and `rwb_source_data` belong to rwb-case, rwb-decision, rwb-guarantee, rwb-valuation and rwb-source-data and are only read or answered through their contracts, never written.

**Configuration and reference data.** Reference data is read under DP-06 and DP-07: the parameters are the rule rows and the LOV lists named below, and their reference-data contract is Not specified in the source documents (DOR-RWB-S8-E7007-APP-20).

**Screen states.** SCR-08 Deviation queue and SCR-06 Raise deviation each show: an empty state when the case has no open deviation; a loading state while the outcome is read; an error state with the platform error envelope of X5; and a no-access state with MSG-P4-002 when the Case record right U is not held (X2).

**Open decisions.** Open decision DL22 is still open and is carried with its assumptions ASM-1162, ASM-1304, ASM-2217 and ASM-2569, each confirmed by the directive of 26 November 2026; the build proceeds on those assumptions until DL22 closes.
